issue.title: Host finalizer git-push 500 matches claude retry pattern 'Internal server error' and re-runs the whole agent
issue.description:
Provider retry classification runs over the entire workflow step error string, and that string includes stderr from host-owned finalizers such as `sase stitch create --resume` and git push. Generic provider retry patterns therefore match non-provider failures and trigger full in-process agent re-runs.

Root cause: `handle_workflow_error` passes `str(exc)` for any step failure to `is_retryable_error` / `find_retry_config_for_error`, which do case-insensitive substring matching. Nothing separates a provider/LLM-invocation failure from a host finalizer failure inside the same `Step 'main' failed: …` error.

Possible directions (the worker should choose): classify host finalizer/commit-publish failures with a typed exception or marker that provider retry matching never sees, and let the finalizer's own durable retry (`--resume`) handle it; or scope provider retry matching to provider-invocation output only. Keep real Claude API "Internal server error" retries working.

task_type_fields.impact: A transient host-side publish failure (GitHub 500 on push), which `sase stitch create --resume` could retry by itself, instead costs a full extra LLM agent turn (an Opus turn here, ~5 minutes) and feeds the agent a misleading "provider failure" nudge. The re-run also made the run a retried run, which exposed the separate continuation-replay `missing_parent` fork bug: `research.3x.image` (`#fork:research.3x.final`) then failed at launch. Any provider retry pattern that is a generic HTTP phrase ("Internal server error", "rate limit", "Too Many Requests") can match git/gh/finalizer stderr in the same way.
task_type_fields.repro:
Observed 2026-10-07 on `research.3x.final` (project gh_bobs-org__bob-cli, artifacts dir `~/.sase/projects/gh_bobs-org__bob-cli/artifacts/ace-run/202610/07/20261007100742`):

1. Attempt 1 finished its work, then the host commit finalizer failed: `Step 'main' failed: Error: sase stitch create --resume failed for research: ❌ finalize_commit created local commit 99e35dd… but failed before publishing it … git push failed after rebase retries: remote: Internal Server Error … ! [remote rejected] main -> main (Internal Server Error)` (see `attempts/01/attempt_meta.json` → `error_full`).
2. `handle_workflow_error` (`src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_retry.py`) matched that string against provider retry configs. `is_retryable_error` (`src/sase/llm_provider/retry_config.py`) does a case-insensitive substring match over the whole step error, and the shipped claude retry pattern `"Internal server error"` (`src/sase/default_config.yml`, `llm_provider.retry.claude.error_patterns`) matched GitHub's `remote: Internal Server Error`.
3. The runner waited 60s (claude `wait_times[0]`), snapshotted attempt 1 into `attempts/01/`, and re-ran the entire agent turn in-process with `_RETRY_CONTINUATION_NUDGE` ("Your previous attempt hit a model context limit or transient provider failure…"). `retry_started_at` in `agent_meta.json` records it.

Repro sketch: run `is_retryable_error(<the error_full above>, <merged claude ProviderRetryConfig>)` → True; or unit-test `handle_workflow_error` with a `RuntimeError` whose text contains a finalizer push failure with "Internal Server Error".

issue.creation_reason: Found while diagnosing the research.3x.image fork failure: a GitHub push 500 inside the host commit finalizer was misclassified as a Claude provider error. That re-ran the whole agent and set up the separate missing_parent fork bug.
